subject: E-3381: totals mismatch on Linux
body:
Hi, I'm using MeshMail 2.8.4 on Ubuntu 24.04. Since Monday, every time I export
the report, I get 'E-3381: totals do not match source'.

Two colleagues imported the identical period independently. The reported totals
are roughly double the source values.

I've already tried rebooting the router, which changed nothing.

Regards, Tomas Vik, Ferro & Sons
